label: 场 FBM 扰动
description: 用一张低频 FBM 值噪声对输入标量场做零均值加性扰动：out = clamp0(field + (fbm-0.5)*2*amplitude)。典型用途是把距离场的「等距同心等值线」打散——阈值化后得到的分界不再与源轮廓平行，而是忽宽忽窄、带海湾与岬角的自然线条。因为噪声零均值，阈值的语义（平均格数）保持不变。约定与距离场电池对齐：region 外无效格恒输出 0；field<0（BFS 不可达 -1）原样透传不参与扰动；扰动后下限截断到 0，保证仍能被 alg_field_threshold 的 0<=field<=threshold 判为近处。
description-en: Applies a zero-mean additive perturbation from a low-frequency FBM value-noise field: out = clamp0(field + (fbm-0.5)*2*amplitude). The typical use is to break up the evenly-spaced concentric iso-contours of a distance field, so thresholded boundaries no longer parallel the source outline but wander with bays and headlands. Because the noise is zero-mean, threshold semantics (average cell count) are preserved. Conventions match the distance batteries: cells outside region always output 0; field<0 (BFS-unreachable -1) passes through untouched; the perturbed value is clamped at 0 so it can still satisfy alg_field_threshold's 0<=field<=threshold near test.

inputs.name: field
inputs.label: 输入标量场
inputs.description: 待扰动的标量场 number[][]（如 alg_field_inner_distance 的距离场）。约定：无效格 0、源格 0、不可达 -1。
inputs.description-en: The scalar field number[][] to perturb (e.g. the distance field from alg_field_inner_distance). Convention: invalid cells 0, source cells 0, unreachable -1.

inputs.name: region
inputs.label: 有效范围
inputs.description: 限定有效范围的掩码，非零格为有效格。只有有效格被扰动，其余恒输出 0。应与产出 field 的那张 region 一致。
inputs.description-en: Mask bounding the valid cells; non-zero cells are valid. Only valid cells are perturbed, the rest always output 0. Should be the same region the field was built from.

inputs.name: amplitude
inputs.label: 扰动幅度
inputs.description: 扰动幅度（与 field 同单位，距离场即格数）：逐格偏移落在 ±amplitude 内。0 = 原样透传（退化为均匀等距等值线）。推荐 1~4。
inputs.description-en: Perturbation amplitude in the field's own unit (cells for a distance field): the per-cell offset lies within ±amplitude. 0 = pass-through (uniform concentric contours). Recommended 1–4.

inputs.name: featureScale
inputs.label: 波动频率
inputs.description: 噪声空间频率，越小波浪越长（大尺度海湾），越大越细碎。推荐 0.03~0.15。
inputs.description-en: Spatial frequency of the noise; smaller = longer waves (large bays), larger = finer detail. Recommended 0.03–0.15.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 噪声种子，0 使用当前时间戳。同一 seed + 同一输入结果确定。多层分带请用不同 seed，让各层分界互不平行。
inputs.description-en: Noise seed; 0 uses the current timestamp. Same seed + same input is deterministic. Use different seeds per band so the boundaries are not parallel.

outputs.name: field
outputs.label: 扰动后标量场
outputs.description: 与输入同形状的标量场：有效格 = clamp0(field + 零均值 FBM 偏移)，不可达格保持 -1，region 外 = 0。可直接喂 alg_field_threshold。
outputs.description-en: A scalar field matching the input shape: valid cells = clamp0(field + zero-mean FBM offset), unreachable cells stay -1, cells outside region = 0. Feeds alg_field_threshold directly.
